meanings.tr: el yapımı tarihi eser, sanat eseri
meanings.en: an object made by a human, especially of historical interest
meanings.exampleEn: The museum displayed an ancient artifact from the Roman era.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, Roma döneminden kalma antik bir eseri sergiledi.

meanings.en: the act of removing someone's doubts or fears
meanings.exampleEn: She gave me reassurance that everything would be fine.
meanings.exampleTr: Her şeyin yolunda olacağına dair bana güvence verdi.

meanings.en: to make pain or a problem less severe
meanings.exampleEn: This medicine should alleviate the pain.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ilaç ağrıyı hafifletmeli.

meanings.en: having had doubts or fears removed
meanings.exampleEn: I felt reassured after talking to the doctor.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorla konuştuktan sonra içim rahatladı.

meanings.en: food remaining after a meal
meanings.exampleEn: We ate the leftover from last night's dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Dün akşamki yemekten kalan artığı yedik.

meanings.en: remaining after most has gone
meanings.exampleEn: There was some residual damage after the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınadan sonra geriye kalan bazı hasarlar vardı.

meanings.en: small remaining parts of something
meanings.exampleEn: The remnants of the old castle still stand on the hill.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski kalenin kalıntıları hâlâ tepede duruyor.

meanings.en: the remains of a destroyed building
meanings.exampleEn: We visited the ancient ruins of the temple.
meanings.exampleTr: Tapınağın antik harabelerini ziyaret ettik.

meanings.tr: çarpıcı bir şekilde, göze çarpacak şekilde
meanings.en: in a way that is noticeable or impressive
meanings.exampleEn: The two sisters look strikingly similar.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kardeş çarpıcı bir şekilde birbirine benziyor.

meanings.en: a signal for someone to do something
meanings.exampleEn: The actor missed his cue and entered late.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncu işaretini kaçırdı ve sahneye geç girdi.

meanings.en: a stock of plays or pieces a company can perform
meanings.exampleEn: The theatre has a wide repertory of classic plays.
meanings.exampleTr: Tiyatronun geniş bir klasik oyun repertuarı var.

meanings.en: the act of saying or doing something again
meanings.exampleEn: His speech was a reiteration of earlier promises.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşması önceki vaatlerin bir yinelemesiydi.

meanings.en: to hold back or control someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: The guards had to restrain the angry crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Görevliler öfkeli kalabalığı dizginlemek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: the act of stopping something by force
meanings.exampleEn: The suppression of free speech angered many citizens.
meanings.exampleTr: İfade özgürlüğünün bastırılması birçok vatandaşı öfkelendirdi.

meanings.en: to publish or produce something again
meanings.exampleEn: The publisher decided to reissue the classic novel.
meanings.exampleTr: Yayınevi klasik romanı yeniden yayımlamaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: a revised or updated version of a publication
meanings.exampleEn: A new edition of the textbook was released this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Ders kitabının yeni baskısı bu yıl çıktı.

meanings.en: the first printed version of a book
meanings.exampleEn: Collectors pay a lot for a first edition of this book.
meanings.exampleTr: Koleksiyoncular bu kitabın ilk baskısı için çok para öder.

meanings.en: the act of leaving or stopping something
meanings.exampleEn: Quitting smoking improved his health a lot.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigarayı bırakmak sağlığını çok iyileştirdi.

meanings.en: resounding or reverberating
meanings.exampleEn: Her echoing footsteps filled the empty hall.
meanings.exampleTr: Yankılanan ayak sesleri boş salonu doldurdu.

meanings.en: having a deep, full, resonant sound
meanings.exampleEn: The priest read the prayer in a sonorous voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Rahip duayı gür ve derin bir sesle okudu.

meanings.en: made quieter or less clear
meanings.exampleEn: We heard a muffled sound from the next room.
meanings.exampleTr: Yan odadan boğuk bir ses duyduk.

meanings.en: in a proper or respectable way
meanings.exampleEn: He always treats his employees decently.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışanlarına her zaman düzgünce davranır.

meanings.tr: utanç verici şekilde, ayıp bir biçimde
meanings.en: in a disgraceful or dishonorable way
meanings.exampleEn: The prisoners were treated shamefully by the guards.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkumlara gardiyanlar tarafından utanç verici şekilde davranıldı.

meanings.en: regarded with respect or approval
meanings.exampleEn: She is an admired leader in her community.
meanings.exampleTr: O, toplumunda hayran olunan bir liderdir.

meanings.en: the process of taking air in and out of the lungs
meanings.exampleEn: His breathing became slow and steady as he slept.
meanings.exampleTr: Uyurken nefes alışı yavaş ve düzenli hale geldi.

meanings.en: relating to the lungs
meanings.exampleEn: The patient suffered from a pulmonary disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasta bir akciğer hastalığından muzdaripti.

meanings.en: to start something again
meanings.exampleEn: Please restart the computer to fix the problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorunu çözmek için lütfen bilgisayarı yeniden başlatın.

meanings.en: a person or company that sells goods in large quantities
meanings.exampleEn: The shop buys its fruit directly from a wholesaler.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkân meyvelerini doğrudan bir toptancıdan alır.

meanings.en: to increase in speed
meanings.exampleEn: The car began to accelerate down the highway.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba otoyolda hızlanmaya başladı.

meanings.en: to move or act quickly, or cause to happen sooner
meanings.exampleEn: The medicine will hasten her recovery.
meanings.exampleTr: İlaç onun iyileşmesini hızlandıracak.

meanings.en: punishment inflicted in return for a wrong
meanings.exampleEn: He swore vengeance against his enemies.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşmanlarından intikam almaya yemin etti.

meanings.en: the act of returning harm for harm
meanings.exampleEn: The attack was carried out in retaliation for the bombing.
meanings.exampleTr: Saldırı, bombalamaya misilleme olarak gerçekleştirildi.

meanings.en: great respect or reverence
meanings.exampleEn: The saint is held in great veneration by believers.
meanings.exampleTr: Aziz, inananlar tarafından büyük bir saygıyla anılır.

meanings.en: an increase or revival after a period of decline
meanings.exampleEn: There has been a resurgence of interest in vinyl records.
meanings.exampleTr: Plaklara olan ilgide yeniden bir canlanma yaşandı.

meanings.en: the act of making something new or extending it
meanings.exampleEn: You must pay a fee for the renewal of your license.
meanings.exampleTr: Ehliyetinizin yenilenmesi için bir ücret ödemelisiniz.

meanings.tr: canlandırmak, ihya etmek, yeniden hayata döndürmek
meanings.en: to revive someone from unconsciousness or death
meanings.exampleEn: The paramedics tried to resuscitate the drowning man.
meanings.exampleTr: Sağlık görevlileri boğulan adamı canlandırmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: an act of resistance or rebellion against authority
meanings.exampleEn: The peasants led an uprising against the king.
meanings.exampleTr: Köylüler krala karşı bir ayaklanma başlattı.

meanings.en: an act of armed resistance against a government
meanings.exampleEn: The rebellion was quickly crushed by the army.
meanings.exampleTr: İsyan ordu tarafından hızla bastırıldı.

meanings.en: innovative or pioneering
meanings.exampleEn: The scientist made a groundbreaking discovery.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanı çığır açan bir keşif yaptı.

meanings.en: a large animal with a horn on its nose; a rhinoceros
meanings.exampleEn: We saw a rhino grazing near the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Nehrin yakınında otlayan bir gergedan gördük.

meanings.tr: birbirine benzer ses çıkarmak, kulağa aynı gelmek
meanings.en: to have a similar sound
meanings.exampleEn: The words 'their' and 'there' sound alike.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Their' ve 'there' kelimeleri kulağa aynı geliyor.

meanings.en: careful, deliberate and controlled
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a measured response to the difficult question.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor soruya ölçülü bir yanıt verdi.

meanings.en: a man who rides horses, especially skillfully
meanings.exampleEn: The horseman galloped across the open field.
meanings.exampleTr: Atlı, açık tarlanın üzerinden dörtnala geçti.

meanings.en: the top of a hill or wave
meanings.exampleEn: The surfer rode the crest of the wave.
meanings.exampleTr: Sörfçü dalganın tepesinde ilerledi.

meanings.en: the quality of being evil or morally wrong
meanings.exampleEn: The story warns against the wickedness of greed.
meanings.exampleTr: Hikâye, açgözlülüğün kötülüğüne karşı uyarır.

meanings.en: to tear or cut into small pieces
meanings.exampleEn: Please shred these confidential documents.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen bu gizli belgeleri parçalayın.

meanings.tr: laf kalabalığı yapmak, dağınık konuşmak; başıboş gezinmek
meanings.en: to talk or write in a confused, lengthy way
meanings.exampleEn: He tends to ramble when he gets nervous.
meanings.exampleTr: Heyecanlandığında lafı dağıtma eğilimindedir.

meanings.en: cooked in an oven
meanings.exampleEn: We had freshly baked bread for breakfast.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahvaltıda taze fırınlanmış ekmek yedik.

meanings.en: covered with stones, or cold and unfeeling
meanings.exampleEn: They walked along the stony path to the beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahile giden taşlık patikada yürüdüler.

meanings.en: having a rough, uneven surface; tough
meanings.exampleEn: The hikers crossed the rugged mountain terrain.
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüşçüler engebeli dağ arazisini geçtiler.

meanings.en: a person you share a flat with
meanings.exampleEn: My flatmate does the cooking and I do the cleaning.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev arkadaşım yemek yapar, ben de temizliği yaparım.

meanings.en: a person you share a house with
meanings.exampleEn: I get along well with all my housemates.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün ev arkadaşlarımla iyi geçinirim.

meanings.en: showing signs of future success
meanings.exampleEn: She is a promising young athlete.
meanings.exampleTr: O, umut verici genç bir sporcudur.

meanings.en: to clean something by rubbing hard
meanings.exampleEn: She had to scrub the floor until it was clean.
meanings.exampleTr: Yer temizlenene kadar onu ovalamak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: a small piece of material on the floor
meanings.exampleEn: Please wipe your feet on the mat before entering.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen girmeden önce ayaklarınızı paspasa silin.

meanings.en: the busiest time of the day, especially for traffic
meanings.exampleEn: Traffic is terrible during peak hour.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoğun saatte trafik berbat oluyor.

meanings.en: damaged or worn away by chemical action
meanings.exampleEn: The old pipes were badly corroded.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski borular fena halde paslanmıştı.

meanings.tr: pratiğini kaybetmiş, eli ayağı tutmaz olmuş (beceride)
meanings.en: no longer skilled because of lack of recent practice
meanings.exampleEn: I'm out of practice; I haven't played piano in years.
meanings.exampleTr: Pratiğimi kaybettim; yıllardır piyano çalmadım.

meanings.en: shiny from rubbing; or skillful and refined
meanings.exampleEn: The performer gave a polished performance.
meanings.exampleTr: Sanatçı kusursuz bir performans sergiledi.

meanings.en: a man known for his wisdom and good judgment
meanings.exampleEn: The villagers asked the wise man for advice.
meanings.exampleTr: Köylüler bilge kişiden tavsiye istedi.

meanings.en: the ability to persuade people to buy things
meanings.exampleEn: A good salesperson needs strong selling skill.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi bir satış elemanının güçlü satış becerisine ihtiyacı vardır.

meanings.tr: oturma odası, salon; dükkân (ör. güzellik salonu)
meanings.en: a sitting room or a shop providing services
meanings.exampleEn: She got her nails done at the beauty parlor.
meanings.exampleTr: Tırnaklarını güzellik salonunda yaptırdı.

meanings.en: clean and likely to prevent disease
meanings.exampleEn: It is important to keep the kitchen hygienic.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfağı hijyenik tutmak önemlidir.

meanings.en: dirty and likely to cause disease
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant was closed due to unsanitary conditions.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran sağlıksız koşullar nedeniyle kapatıldı.

meanings.en: dirty enough to harm health
meanings.exampleEn: The refugees lived in insanitary and crowded conditions.
meanings.exampleTr: Mülteciler sağlıksız ve kalabalık koşullarda yaşıyordu.

meanings.en: a small mark or flaw that spoils appearance
meanings.exampleEn: There was a small blemish on the otherwise perfect apple.
meanings.exampleTr: Aksi takdirde kusursuz olan elmanın üzerinde küçük bir leke vardı.

meanings.en: a deep red color
meanings.exampleEn: Her cheeks turned crimson with embarrassment.
meanings.exampleTr: Yanakları utançtan kızıla döndü.

meanings.en: planned or organized in advance
meanings.exampleEn: The meeting was arranged for next Monday.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı gelecek pazartesi için ayarlandı.

meanings.en: not planned or arranged in advance
meanings.exampleEn: The plane made an unscheduled stop in Paris.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçak Paris'te planlanmamış bir mola verdi.

meanings.en: a planned series of events or a TV/radio broadcast
meanings.exampleEn: My favorite programme is on television tonight.
meanings.exampleTr: En sevdiğim program bu akşam televizyonda.
